name: slug
label: Organization or enterprise slug
help: The name in the account's GitHub address, e.g. **octo-org** in `https://github.com/octo-org` or `https://github.com/enterprises/octo-org`.

name: accessToken
label: Personal access token (classic)
help: Create one in [GitHub token settings](https://github.com/settings/tokens) with the **manage_billing:copilot** and **read:org** scopes, plus **read:enterprise** and **manage_billing:enterprise** for enterprises. The token owner must be an organization owner (organizations), or an enterprise owner or billing manager (enterprises). Model Policies also needs **admin:org**.

name: apiUrl
label: API URL
help: Change only for GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency, e.g. `https://api.octocorp.ghe.com`.
